Appearance.Body: Elongated fuzzy, glowing body with a pressure-sensitive inner bladder
Appearance.Legs: Short articulated limbs for scuttling and hydraulic leaping
Appearance.Head: Furry mustache-like palps for sensing and self-grooming
Appearance.Grooming System: Palps comb mineral dust and sulfur residue from the face valves

Cellular Structure: Partially Eutelic (Fixed brain/valves, regenerative outer shell)

Symbionts.Matrix Slime: extracellular matrix created by Saccharoplasma lentus (not a species)

Social Reactions.Ignore: Passes low-value neighbors without signal exchange.
Social Reactions.Mate: Compatible colonies braid valve filaments and trade shell-building cells for one vent cycle.
Social Reactions.Rob Matrix Housing: Peels away and relocates a section of extracellular matrix created by Saccharoplasma lentus (not a species) when the matrix is under-defended.
